Labor, costs & margin

Base cleaning labor & direct costs

Enter the base service here. Add-on labor and costs are entered with each additional service, so they are counted once.

Extra-service cost estimates

Hours are total person-hours per occurrence. Quantity multiplies both the price and its cost. Include only labor beyond the base service.
